changelog.change: Repointed. The rule cited "Export compliance" in the review guidelines, which has no section by that name. A person chose this section, because it is where Apple documents the ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption key the rule checks.

description: ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption states whether the app uses non-exempt encryption. Without the key, App Store Connect asks the question on every upload, which blocks an automated release pipeline.

remediation.summary: Add ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption to Info.plist and set the correct value for the app.

source.section: Declare Your App's Use of Encryption

title: The export compliance key is not declared

changelog.change: Compiled from apple-app-store-review-guidelines section 3.1.5 at document version 20260901T052521884Z-f9438536. Model confidence 0.60. Awaiting human review.
Promoted. Verification graded it accurate, and it raises no error finding on any of the published apps that ran it.

description: Apps may not perform cryptocurrency mining computation on the device. Detects known mining libraries, hashing algorithm implementations, and stratum mining protocol usage in source or dependencies.

examples: Delete the XMRig/cpuminer dependency and call a cloud mining API instead of hashing locally.
Replace local stratum client connections with a backend service that returns mining results.
remediation.summary: Remove on-device mining code and move any mining computation to a server or cloud service.

title: On-device cryptocurrency mining code or libraries
